events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Launch Research and secure data access
events.decision: Which Quinta Azul sales data and buyer contacts can the team access?
agenda: Present the Spain entry question and the Research workstreams
Discuss the data and people the evidence work needs
Align on owners and dates for each access request

events.label: Check-in: first findings
events.purpose: Review market size and competitor findings
events.decision: Which retail segments should the findings pack take to sign-off?
agenda: Present the Spanish retail market size by segment
Review competitor profiles for Spanish retail olive oil
Discuss which segments the findings pack should carry

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.purpose: Decide whether Spain justifies entry design
events.decision: Is Spain attractive enough to justify designing entry options?
agenda: Present the Spain attractiveness findings pack
Review the competitor, buyer and capability findings behind it
Decide whether to move on to entry option design

events.label: Check-in: entry options
events.purpose: Review entry options before the roadmap
events.decision: Which entry option should the roadmap and go or no-go pack detail?
agenda: Present the entry options compared on agreed criteria
Review how the options differ against the criteria
Discuss which option the roadmap and go or no-go pack detail

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve the Spain go or no-go decision
events.decision: Approve the Spain go or no-go decision and, if go, the entry plan?
agenda: Present the go or no-go decision pack and the business case
Review the entry plan and roadmap for Spanish retail
Decide on the go or no-go and, if go, the entry plan
